maya: Planning a scaled SI enablement run next month. need a compact cert flow and a lightweight trainer playbook. aim for 2 SIs in pilot.

lou: I can run 2 live trainer sessions and produce the async module. will keep async under 30 mins.

fran: I'll own infra: marketplace AMIs, sample terraform, and a short HW compatibility table (A100/H100). target AMIs by 4/8.

joel: marketing will prepare co-branded assets and a partner press one-pager if pilot validates. need final logo pack by 4/15.

maya: certification should be quick: deploy demo app, run perf check p50 <150ms, confirm logs + secrets rotation. pass = 3/4. sophie please review later?

partner-bot: Created task: SI enablement pilot #177700 - owners: lou, fran, joel - due 2026-04-12. link: https://redwood.internal/partners/tasks/177700

lou: async module outline: 1) platform overview 2) infra checklist 3) debugging tips 4) cost tuning 5) quiz. will include a tiny curl smoke test.

fran: question on hardware partners 14 can we request short-term H100 loaners? OEM wants a partner brief. who writes it?

joel: i'll coordinate with marketing and partner ops to draft a one-page brief.

maya: next quick sync Tue 4/6 9am PT to finalize enrollments. I'll send calendar invite.

lou: noted. I'll upload async draft and quiz by 4/10.

maya: thanks team. keep the pilot lean and aim for one success story to expand.
